learning_outcomes.text: To dominate and solve decision problems arising in logistics management based on concrete business data.
Types of logistics and their functions within the enterprise

syllabus_topics: Logistics concepts; logistics concepts; logistics topics: material, spare parts, product, personnel and information logistics; logistics areas: supply, production and distribution logistics.
Place of logistics in business organization; forms of logistics organization.
General objectives of logistics: 5D; strategic and operative objectives pursued in logistics.
Logistics planning: planning principles, planning periods, planning preparations, strategic and operative logistics planning.
Markets from a logistics perspective: industrial, agricultural and service markets; public market; Intermediary market (wholesalers and retailers).
Logistics tools; Logistics software: analysis tools, planning tools; quantitative and qualitative planning techniques.
Logistics hardware: external and internal transport systems; warehouse arrangement techniques; automation in warehouse management; information technologies.
Warehouse/Bonded warehouse logistics and management: warehouse systems, functions, objectives, costs and location preferences.
Production logistics and management: influencing factors; scope; MRP and MRP II; OPT, Kanban; JIT-Production.
Marketing logistics and management: scope, distribution channels; distribution network management; location problem; product and spare part transport problems; route planning.
Logistics-Controlling: Concept, scope, control forms and functions.
Special topics and problems in logistics: Logistics in foreign trade, industrial waste problem; outsourcing vs.
Collective evaluation: What did we learn from the logistics management course in terms of decision topics and decision optimizations?
